info.name: VAST API Swagger Schema activedirectory iodata API

params.name: graph
params.description: True returns data for graphical representation. False returns data as a time series.

params.name: protocol_filter
params.description: Queries analytics only for a specified protocol.

params.name: time_frame
params.description: Time frame over which to query. Specify as a whole integer followed by a unit: 's' or 'S' denotes seconds. 'm' = minutes, 'h' or 'H' = hours, 'd' or 'D' = days, 'w' or 'W' = weeks, 'M' = months, 'y' or 'Y' = years. Examples: for ten minutes, specify '10m'. For three months, specify '3M'.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Start of time frame to query, in the format 2025-02-16T10:00:00.000Z.

params.name: end_time
params.description: End of time frame to query, in the format 2025-02-16T10:00:00.000Z.

items.docs: This endpoint returns data flow analytics.
